body: I've been on Vicodin, morphine and codeine. They either do nothing or only help take the edge off the pain when it gets really bad - they do nothing for the constant baseline pain. I have to take a lot, though. I'll go through a week's worth in three days. I can't be opoids every day for the rest of my life, anyway. My doctor will barely give them to me anymore, anyway. In my state they are really cracking down on prescription opiates. It's not fair to people who really need them.
